language.name: English
app.name: FMX
desc.to_video: Convert videos into this format. Open “Output settings” for codec, hardware encoding, bitrate and frame rate, and “Edit” to clip, crop, rotate, burn in subtitles or add a watermark.
desc.to_audio: Convert audio files, or pull the soundtrack out of videos. Bitrate, sample rate, channels and volume are under “Output settings”.
desc.to_image: Convert pictures natively, with optional resize, rotation and grayscale. HEIC/AVIF inputs are decoded through ffmpeg.
desc.images_to_pdf: Combine pictures into one PDF, one page per image, in list order.
desc.join_video: Concatenate videos in list order into one MP4. Sizes are normalized.
desc.join_audio: Concatenate audio tracks in list order into one file.
desc.mux: Put an audio track onto a video without re-encoding (output: MKV).
desc.trim: Keep only the part between start and end.
desc.compress: Re-encode a video to fit a target file size (H.264 MP4).
desc.remove_audio: Strip all audio tracks without re-encoding the video.
desc.extract_frames: Save one still image every N seconds into a folder.
desc.rotate: Rotate by 90°/180° or mirror the picture.
desc.speed: Speed up or slow down video and audio, keeping pitch.
desc.normalize: Even out loudness to the EBU R128 broadcast standard.
hint.output_change: Choose a folder for the finished files
hint.stop_all: Cancel every queued and running job
hint.output_reset: Save outputs next to their source files
hint.mux_order: Add the video first, then the audio file.
hint.stream_copy: Instant and lossless, but cuts land on the nearest keyframe.
files.empty: Drop files here or click “Add files…”
queue.title: Queue
queue.empty: No jobs yet. Pick a tool, add files and press “Add to queue”.
settings.title: Settings
settings.auto_start: Start jobs as soon as they are added
error.wrong_input_count: This tool needs {needed} file(s) but {got} were given.
error.no_video: The file has no video stream.
error.no_audio: The file has no audio stream.
error.bad_timestamp: “{value}” is not a valid time. Use ss, mm:ss or hh:mm:ss.
error.empty_trim: The end time must be after the start time and inside the file.
error.target_too_small: The target size is too small for this video's length.
error.unsupported_tool: This tool cannot run through ffmpeg.
desc.to_ebook: Convert eBooks and documents (EPUB, FB2, DOCX, ODT, HTML, TXT…) to EPUB, FB2, PDF or TXT — built in. Kindle formats (MOBI, AZW3), and reading MOBI or PDF books, need Calibre.
desc.pdf_to_images: Render every PDF page as an image.
desc.pdf_to_text: Extract the text of a PDF, keeping its layout.
desc.pdf_to_html: Turn a PDF into a single HTML page.
desc.pdf_to_word: Convert a PDF into an editable Word document (text and page breaks).
desc.office_to_pdf: Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, CSV, Markdown, HTML and text files to PDF — built in, no office suite needed.
desc.pdf_merge: Combine PDFs into one, in list order.
desc.pdf_split: Save every page of a PDF as its own file.
desc.pdf_compress: Shrink a PDF by downsampling its images (Ghostscript).
desc.dvd_to_video: Rip a DVD (disc folder, VIDEO_TS folder or ISO image) to a video file.
desc.cd_to_audio: Rip every track of an audio CD to separate files.
desc.folder_to_iso: Build an ISO image from a folder; DVD folders get a DVD-Video layout.
desc.iso_to_cso: Compress an ISO image into the CSO format.
desc.cso_to_iso: Expand a CSO image back into a plain ISO.
desc.audio_mix: Play several audio files on top of each other in one track.
desc.video_mix: Show two videos together: side by side, stacked, or picture-in-picture.
desc.split: Cut a file into equal pieces without re-encoding.
desc.delogo: Blur away a logo or watermark inside a rectangle.
desc.volume: Make audio louder or quieter; video is copied untouched.
desc.repair: Rebuild broken timestamps and drop corrupt packets without re-encoding.
desc.download: Download a video or its audio from a web page.
desc.record: Record the screen, with optional microphone or system audio.
after.label: When done:
hint.download_rights: Only download content you have the right to save.
hint.edit_applies: These edits apply to the files added in this batch only.
hint.mix_order: The first file is the main video.
info.title: Media info — {name}
input.capture: Records until you press Stop in the queue.
shutdown.title: Shutting down
shutdown.countdown: All jobs are done. The computer shuts down in {secs} s.
record.system_picks: When recording starts, your system asks which screen or window to share.
record.no_screen: No screen was found to record.
record.needs_gstreamer: Recording on Wayland needs GStreamer with its PipeWire plugin (gstreamer1.0-pipewire on Debian and Ubuntu, gstreamer1-plugin-pipewire on Fedora).
record.mac_permission: The first time, macOS asks to allow FMX in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen Recording (and Microphone for sound). Allow it, then start again.
record.loopback_windows: To record computer sound, turn on Stereo Mix in the Sound control panel (Recording tab) or install a virtual audio cable.
record.loopback_mac: To record computer sound, install a loopback driver such as BlackHole.
error.screen_share: The system did not share the screen. {error}
error.missing_program: {program} is not installed. Install it, then press “Scan again” in Settings.
error.bad_url: Enter a web address starting with http:// or https://.
error.bad_list: That file is not an FMX task list.
error.list_too_big: The task list file is too large.
error.no_output: The program finished without producing a file.
error.no_tracks: No audio tracks were found on the disc.
error.invalid_rect: The rectangle lies outside the video frame.
error.not_cso: This is not a CSO image.
error.invalid_watermark: Choose an existing watermark image file.
desc.to_device: Convert videos to MP4 tuned for this device: screen size, H.264 profile and bitrate. Clip, crop and watermark are under “Edit”.
desc.join_images: Stitch pictures into one, top to bottom or side by side.
desc.pdf_to_excel: Turn the tables and text of a PDF into an Excel workbook, one sheet per page.
desc.bluray_to_video: Rip an unencrypted Blu-ray (disc folder or ISO) to a video file.
desc.disc_to_iso: Copy a whole disc from a drive into an ISO image.
desc.crop: Cut away the edges of the picture. Draw the area to keep on the video, or type it.
desc.add_subtitles: Add a subtitle file as a selectable track, without re-encoding (output: MKV).
desc.extract_subtitles: Save the first text subtitle track of a video as an SRT file.
error.no_crop: Draw or enter a crop area first.
error.no_subtitle_stream: The file has no subtitle track.

help.combine: Add {count} or more files. They are combined from top to bottom — use the arrows to change the order.
help.in_order: Add one or more files. They are used from top to bottom — use the arrows to change the order.
help.each_file: Add one or more files. Each one is processed on its own.
help.each_folder: Add one or more folders. Each one is processed on its own.
help.device: The drive that holds the disc, for example /dev/sr0 or D:
help.settings: The defaults work well. Change them only if you need to.
help.trim: Play through the video and drag the two blue handles on the timeline to where the part starts and ends.
help.crop: Drag on the picture to draw the area you want to keep. Everything outside it is cut away.
help.delogo: Drag on the picture to draw a box around the logo. That area is blurred away.
help.rotate: Rotate 90°, 180° or mirror the picture. The live preview shows the result.
hint.add_folder_scan: Adds every supported file inside a folder and its subfolders.
hint.resolution: Larger videos are scaled down; smaller ones are left as they are.
hint.speed: 1× is normal speed, 2× twice as fast, 0.5× half as fast.
hint.target_size: The finished file will be about this big.
hint.rect_exact: Or type the exact position and size in pixels.

need.url: Paste a web address to continue.
preview.add_file_first: Add a video above to see it here.
preview.same_for_all: The same settings are used for every file in the list.

preview.set_end_hint: The kept part ends at the current picture.
preview.timeline_hint: Click or drag to move through the video.

settings.ytdlp_hint: yt-dlp ships with FMX and is updated with each FMX release.

update.available_hint: An update is ready in Settings → Updates.
about.description: Convert video, music, pictures, documents and discs. Free, simple, all in one app.
about.license: FMX is free and open source, under the MIT or Apache 2.0 license, as you choose.
about.third_party_hint: Includes ffmpeg and yt-dlp, each under its own license.
download.container_mp4_hint: Plays everywhere: phones, TVs and editors.
download.container_mkv_hint: Keeps the original streams and every subtitle; best for PCs.
download.container_webm_hint: Open format for browsers; may not play on some phones and TVs.
download.quality_hint: Larger is sharper but takes longer to download.

download.playlist_hint: For links to a playlist or a video in one. Items go into a folder named after it.
download.subtitle_langs_hint: Language codes separated by commas, e.g. en,es,fr

download.paste_hint: Paste a link from YouTube or another video site; its details appear here.

settings.debug_short: Keeps a detailed log for problem reports.

settings.shell_short: Convert files right from your file manager.
